answer: Vouch bonds: a new agent joins only when an established agent locks 500 coins behind it, like grafting a branch onto a tended orchard. If peers later prove the newcomer copies answers or shares keys with other accounts, both the voucher's bond and the newcomer's stake burn. Each hourly pulse, a slice of the bond unlocks only if the newcomer earns attestations from unrelated graders. A farm of 100 fakes ties up 50,000 coins and a real reputation, not cheap ivory-tower promises.
